## 📊 Rank Flows (Bump Chart) for Year–Country–Counts

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# Rectangular Rank Flow：矩形条带 + 斜向连接 + 入/出场楔形
# 关键：缩短每年矩形（tile_inset），把交叉放在年份之间的过渡区
# ============================================================
# 依赖包（首次运行请先安装）：
# install.packages("tidyverse")
 library(tidyverse)
 library(ggbump)
 library(scales)
 library(tidyverse)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=20, fig.height=6}
# 10 Years: tile_inset   = 0.08,  label_size = 3.8 
#  6 Years: tile_inset   = 0.15,  label_size = 5.3
csv_path    = "/Users/zixuanzhao/Desktop/MKG/JMI邀稿文章/Rectangular-Rank-Flow.csv"  # Year, Countries, Counts
top_n       = 7
label_mode  = "both"   # "both"=“计数+国家”；"country"=只显示国家
font_family = NULL

# 外观
lane_half    = 0.50
gap_year     = 0.48
tile_inset   = 0.15
conn_overlap = 0.20
eps          = 0.002   # 边界微重叠，消除拼接缝

# 标签更大
label_size = 5.3 #
label_face = "bold"

# 配色
palette_vals = c(
  "#53A93F", "#0B5D50", "#7FB3FF", "#BB1E10", "#FFB300",
  "#FFCC00", "#0B74C8", "#FDB462", "#8E24AA", "#6D6E71",
  "#1976D2", "#D81B60", "#00897B", "#5D4037"
)

# ---------- 读入后：把 Countries 做“可控换行” ----------
wrap_map <- c(
  "Electrodeposition" = "Electro-\nDeposition",
  "SurfaceReactivity" = "Surface\nReactivity",  
  "MolecularDynamics" = "Molecular\nDynamics", 
  "Microstructure" = "Micro-\nStructure"
  # 需要哪个就继续加
)

ranked = df %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  arrange(desc(Counts), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_df = ranked %>% filter(Rank <= top_n)
stopifnot(nrow(plot_df) > 0)
years = sort(unique(plot_df$Year))

# 标签内容
tiles_label = if (label_mode == "country") {
  plot_df %>% transmute(Year, Rank, Countries, label = Countries)
} else {
  plot_df %>% transmute(Year, Rank, Countries, label = paste0(Counts, " ", Countries))
}

# ---------- 每年矩形（缩短 + 轻微外扩覆盖 eps） ----------
tiles = plot_df %>%
  transmute(
    Countries, Counts, Year, Rank,
    xmin = Year - (gap_year - tile_inset) - eps,
    xmax = Year + (gap_year - tile_inset) + eps,
    ymin = Rank - lane_half,
    ymax = Rank + lane_half
  ) %>%
  left_join(tiles_label, by = c("Year","Rank","Countries"))

# ---------- 连接块 ----------
make_connector = function(df_year_t, df_year_t1, year_t) {
  d = df_year_t %>% select(Countries, r0 = Rank) %>%
      inner_join(df_year_t1 %>% select(Countries, r1 = Rank), by = "Countries")
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble())

  xL_in = year_t + (gap_year - tile_inset)
  xR_in = year_t + 1 - (gap_year - tile_inset)

  xL_in2 = xL_in - conn_overlap - eps
  xL_in_o = xL_in + eps
  xR_in_o = xR_in - eps
  xR_in2 = xR_in + conn_overlap + eps

  purrr::pmap_dfr(d, function(Countries, r0, r1){
    tibble(
      Countries = Countries,
      x = c(xL_in2, xL_in_o, xR_in_o, xR_in2, xR_in_o, xL_in_o),
      y = c(r0 - lane_half, r0 - lane_half, r1 - lane_half,
            r1,              r1 + lane_half, r0 + lane_half),
      pid = paste0(Countries, "_", year_t)
    )
  })
}

connectors = purrr::map_dfr(
  1:(length(years) - 1),
  ~ make_connector(
      plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x]),
      plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x + 1]),
      years[.x]
    )
)

# ---------- 入/出场楔形（带 eps 无缝衔接） ----------
make_entries = function(df_prev, df_curr, year_t, wedge = conn_overlap){
  d = df_curr %>% anti_join(df_prev, by = "Countries") %>% transmute(Countries, r = Rank)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble())
  x_in  = year_t - (gap_year - tile_inset)
  x_tip = x_in - wedge - eps
  purrr::pmap_dfr(d, function(Countries, r){
    tibble(
      Countries = Countries,
      x = c(x_tip, x_in + eps, x_in + eps, x_tip),
      y = c(r,     r - lane_half, r + lane_half, r),
      gid = paste0(Countries, "_entry_", year_t)
    )
  })
}

make_exits = function(df_curr, df_next, year_t, wedge = conn_overlap){
  d = df_curr %>% anti_join(df_next, by = "Countries") %>% transmute(Countries, r = Rank)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble())
  x_in  = year_t + (gap_year - tile_inset)
  x_tip = x_in + wedge + eps
  purrr::pmap_dfr(d, function(Countries, r){
    tibble(
      Countries = Countries,
      x = c(x_in - eps, x_tip, x_tip, x_in - eps),
      y = c(r - lane_half, r, r, r + lane_half),
      gid = paste0(Countries, "_exit_", year_t)
    )
  })
}

entries = purrr::map_dfr(2:length(years), ~ make_entries(
  plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x-1]),
  plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x]),
  years[.x]
))
exits = purrr::map_dfr(1:(length(years)-1), ~ make_exits(
  plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x]),
  plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x+1]),
  years[.x]
))

# ---------- 颜色映射（稳定） ----------
countries_order = plot_df %>%
  group_by(Countries) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Counts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>% pull(Countries)
country_colours = setNames(rep(palette_vals, length.out = length(countries_order)),
                           countries_order)

# ---------- 主题（去掉外边距与灰白边） ----------
# ---- 主题（只贴出需修改的部分）----
base_theme = theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", colour = NA),

    axis.title = element_blank(),
    # 关键：给 y 轴文字加右侧外边距，让数字与绘图区拉开距离
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "#666666", face = "bold",
                               margin = margin(r = 3)),  # ← 调大 r 就更宽
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "#666666", face = "bold",
                           margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, colour = "#666666"),

    # 给整图左侧留一点图外边距，避免数字贴到画布边缘
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 6)   # ← 视需要调大/调小
  )

# ---------- 绘图（无边线；零 expand；背景全铺） ----------
y_breaks = 1:top_n
x_breaks = years

p = ggplot() +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = min(years) - 0.5, xmax = max(years) + 0.5,
           ymin = 0.5, ymax = top_n + 0.5, fill = "#F5F5F5") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_breaks + 0.5, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +

  # ── connectors ──
  { if (nrow(connectors) > 0)
      geom_polygon(data = connectors,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, group = pid, fill = Countries),
                   colour = NA, linewidth = 0) } +

  # ── entries ──
  { if (nrow(entries) > 0)
      geom_polygon(data = entries,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, group = gid, fill = Countries),
                   colour = NA, linewidth = 0) } +

  # ── exits ──
  { if (nrow(exits) > 0)
      geom_polygon(data = exits,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, group = gid, fill = Countries),
                   colour = NA, linewidth = 0) } +

  geom_rect(
    data = tiles,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Countries),
    colour = NA, linewidth = 0
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = tiles,
    aes(x = Year, y = Rank, label = label),
    size = label_size, colour = "white", fontface = label_face, lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = y_breaks, limits = c(top_n + 0.5, 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks,
                     limits = c(min(years) - 0.5, max(years) + 0.5),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = country_colours) +
  labs(title = "Rectangular Rank Flow (with crossover zone & entries/exits)") +
  base_theme

p
```
```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6, out.width="65%"}
# 图片长度压缩，字体放大版本
# ============================================================
# Rectangular Rank Flow：矩形条带 + 斜向连接 + 入/出场楔形
# ✅ 修复 make_connector() year_t1 未定义报错
# ✅ 年份压缩但不裁切/不灰边（year_spacing 一键控制）
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

csv_path    = "/Users/zixuanzhao/Desktop/MKG/JMI邀稿文章/Rectangular-Rank-Flow.csv"
top_n       = 7
label_mode  = "both"
font_family = NULL

# ======= 只调这个：年份之间的紧凑程度（越小越紧）=======
year_spacing <- 0.85   # 建议 0.75~0.95

lane_half  <- 0.50
eps        <- 0.002

# ======= 几何参数跟随 year_spacing 自动收缩 =======
gap_year     <- year_spacing/2 - 0.04
tile_inset   <- 0.10
conn_overlap <- 0.08

label_size <- 5.3
label_face <- "bold"

palette_vals <- c(
  "#53A93F", "#0B5D50", "#7FB3FF", "#BB1E10", "#FFB300",
  "#FFCC00", "#0B74C8", "#FDB462", "#8E24AA", "#6D6E71",
  "#1976D2", "#D81B60", "#00897B", "#5D4037"
)

# ---------- 1) 读入数据 ----------
df <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Year      = as.integer(Year),
    Countries = as.character(Countries),
    Counts    = as.numeric(Counts)
  )

# ---------- 2) Countries 可控换行 ----------
wrap_map <- c(
  "Electrodeposition"  = "Electro-\nDeposition",
  "SurfaceReactivity"  = "Surface\nReactivity",
  "MolecularDynamics"  = "Molecular\nDynamics",
  "Microstructure"     = "Micro-\nStructure"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Countries = str_replace_all(Countries, "[\r\n]+", " "),
    Countries = str_squish(Countries),
    Countries = recode(Countries, !!!wrap_map)
  )

# ---------- 3) 排名 ----------
ranked <- df %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  arrange(desc(Counts), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_df <- ranked %>% filter(Rank <= top_n)
stopifnot(nrow(plot_df) > 0)

years <- sort(unique(plot_df$Year))

# Year -> Year_pos（0, year_spacing, 2*year_spacing,...）
year_map <- setNames((seq_along(years) - 1) * year_spacing, years)
plot_df  <- plot_df %>% mutate(Year_pos = as.numeric(year_map[as.character(Year)]))

# 标签内容
tiles_label <- if (label_mode == "country") {
  plot_df %>% transmute(Year, Year_pos, Rank, Countries, label = Countries)
} else {
  plot_df %>% transmute(Year, Year_pos, Rank, Countries, label = paste0(Counts, " ", Countries))
}

# ---------- 4) 每年矩形 ----------
tiles <- plot_df %>%
  transmute(
    Countries, Counts, Year, Year_pos, Rank,
    xmin = Year_pos - (gap_year - tile_inset) - eps,
    xmax = Year_pos + (gap_year - tile_inset) + eps,
    ymin = Rank - lane_half,
    ymax = Rank + lane_half
  ) %>%
  left_join(tiles_label, by = c("Year","Year_pos","Rank","Countries"))

# ---------- 5) 连接块（显式传入下一年 year_t1，避免变量名错误） ----------
make_connector <- function(df_year_t, df_year_t1, year_t, year_t1) {
  d <- df_year_t %>% select(Countries, r0 = Rank) %>%
    inner_join(df_year_t1 %>% select(Countries, r1 = Rank), by = "Countries")
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble())

  x_t  <- as.numeric(year_map[as.character(year_t)])
  x_t1 <- as.numeric(year_map[as.character(year_t1)])

  xL_in <- x_t  + (gap_year - tile_inset)
  xR_in <- x_t1 - (gap_year - tile_inset)

  xL_in2  <- xL_in - conn_overlap - eps
  xL_in_o <- xL_in + eps
  xR_in_o <- xR_in - eps
  xR_in2  <- xR_in + conn_overlap + eps

  purrr::pmap_dfr(d, function(Countries, r0, r1){
    tibble(
      Countries = Countries,
      x = c(xL_in2, xL_in_o, xR_in_o, xR_in2, xR_in_o, xL_in_o),
      y = c(r0 - lane_half, r0 - lane_half, r1 - lane_half,
            r1,              r1 + lane_half, r0 + lane_half),
      pid = paste0(Countries, "_", year_t)
    )
  })
}

connectors <- purrr::map_dfr(
  1:(length(years) - 1),
  ~ make_connector(
    plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x]),
    plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x + 1]),
    years[.x],
    years[.x + 1]
  )
)

# ---------- 6) 入/出场楔形 ----------
make_entries <- function(df_prev, df_curr, year_t, wedge = conn_overlap){
  d <- df_curr %>% anti_join(df_prev, by = "Countries") %>% transmute(Countries, r = Rank)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble())

  x_t   <- as.numeric(year_map[as.character(year_t)])
  x_in  <- x_t - (gap_year - tile_inset)
  x_tip <- x_in - wedge - eps

  purrr::pmap_dfr(d, function(Countries, r){
    tibble(
      Countries = Countries,
      x = c(x_tip, x_in + eps, x_in + eps, x_tip),
      y = c(r,     r - lane_half, r + lane_half, r),
      gid = paste0(Countries, "_entry_", year_t)
    )
  })
}

make_exits <- function(df_curr, df_next, year_t, wedge = conn_overlap){
  d <- df_curr %>% anti_join(df_next, by = "Countries") %>% transmute(Countries, r = Rank)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(tibble())

  x_t   <- as.numeric(year_map[as.character(year_t)])
  x_in  <- x_t + (gap_year - tile_inset)
  x_tip <- x_in + wedge + eps

  purrr::pmap_dfr(d, function(Countries, r){
    tibble(
      Countries = Countries,
      x = c(x_in - eps, x_tip, x_tip, x_in - eps),
      y = c(r - lane_half, r, r, r + lane_half),
      gid = paste0(Countries, "_exit_", year_t)
    )
  })
}

entries <- purrr::map_dfr(
  2:length(years),
  ~ make_entries(
    plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x-1]),
    plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x]),
    years[.x]
  )
)

exits <- purrr::map_dfr(
  1:(length(years)-1),
  ~ make_exits(
    plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x]),
    plot_df %>% filter(Year == years[.x+1]),
    years[.x]
  )
)

# ---------- 7) 颜色映射 ----------
countries_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(Countries) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Counts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>% pull(Countries)

country_colours <- setNames(rep(palette_vals, length.out = length(countries_order)),
                            countries_order)

# ---------- 8) x 轴范围：包含楔形尖端，避免两侧“灰/裁切” ----------
pad <- (gap_year - tile_inset) + conn_overlap + 0.06
x_breaks <- as.numeric(year_map)
x_labels <- names(year_map)
x_min <- min(x_breaks) - pad
x_max <- max(x_breaks) + pad

# ---------- 9) 主题 ----------
base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = font_family) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", colour = NA),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#F5F5F5", colour = NA),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, colour = "#666666", face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 3)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = "#666666", face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 4)),
    axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 6)
  )

y_breaks <- 1:top_n

p <- ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = x_min, xmax = x_max,
           ymin = 0.5, ymax = top_n + 0.5, fill = "#F5F5F5") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = y_breaks + 0.5, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  { if (nrow(connectors) > 0)
      geom_polygon(data = connectors,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, group = pid, fill = Countries),
                   colour = NA, linewidth = 0) } +
  { if (nrow(entries) > 0)
      geom_polygon(data = entries,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, group = gid, fill = Countries),
                   colour = NA, linewidth = 0) } +
  { if (nrow(exits) > 0)
      geom_polygon(data = exits,
                   aes(x = x, y = y, group = gid, fill = Countries),
                   colour = NA, linewidth = 0) } +
  geom_rect(data = tiles,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Countries),
            colour = NA, linewidth = 0) +
  geom_text(data = tiles,
            aes(x = Year_pos, y = Rank, label = label),
            size = label_size, colour = "white", fontface = label_face, lineheight = 0.9) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = y_breaks, limits = c(top_n + 0.5, 0.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, labels = x_labels,
                     limits = c(x_min, x_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = country_colours) +
  labs(title = "Rectangular Rank Flow") +
  base_theme

p
```
